note: Internal City memo (preliminary draft) from BPS Chief Planner Patricia Diefenderfer and Principal Planner Ryan Singer to Deputy City Administrator Donnie Oliveira, dated Oct 30, 2026. Obtained and published by KATU with its Nov 4, 2026 story. Archived for research; it is a City analysis, not a PPS document, and makes no recommendation on selling or keeping sites.
